## Purpose and allowed uses

State allowed tasks and whether assets may be used for training, calibration, evaluation, internal display, public display, redistribution, or generated derivatives. Missing permission means the use is prohibited.

## Composition

- Asset/character/artist counts and provenance-source counts.
- Semantic/style/pose/crop/resolution/hair/accessory/complexity slices.
- Synthetic, commissioned, licensed, and transformed portions.
- Annotation types, ignore/uncertain regions, and known missing labels.

## Rights and provenance

- Asset-level rights ledger location and contract/license versions.
- Consent/commission terms and restrictions on commercial model development/distribution.
- Takedown contact/process, revocation effect, and derivative/model handling.
- Duplication/source-family cluster method.

Do not place private art, names, raw paths, or contract details in this repository card; link to the controlled ledger by opaque ID.

## Collection and annotation

Describe acquisition criteria, annotator qualifications/compensation, labeling guideline version, tools, double-annotation rate, disagreement thresholds, adjudication, and inter-annotator agreement.

## Splits and leakage controls

List immutable train/validation/calibration/test/acceptance manifest digests. Splits must be grouped by character, artist, source asset, and derivative/duplicate cluster. State duplicate/audit method and who can access locked labels.

## Quality and limitations

Report missing/corrupt/ambiguous label rates, slice imbalance, annotation upper-bound evidence, domain gaps, potential biases, and uses for which performance cannot be inferred. Explain synthetic-to-real limitations where applicable.

## Privacy and security

State whether records contain personal data, camera/face data, metadata, or stable identities. Record minimization, access controls, retention, deletion/takedown, and incident owner. Assets uploaded or derived through the product flow are permanently ineligible for training, fine-tuning, calibration, evaluation, product improvement, human quality review, fixtures, demonstrations, or marketing, in every phase and regardless of consent. Any future contribution program must acquire a fresh purpose-created asset through a technically and contractually separate non-product flow under asset-specific governance; it must never reuse, backfill, reclassify, or join an existing customer upload, project, derivative, or product-linked identifier.

## Changes

| Version | Manifest digest | Added/removed/relabelled | Reason/rights effect | Evaluation comparability |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Datasets are immutable. Corrections create a new manifest; do not mutate split membership under an existing version.
